widgets_values: Wes Anderson style, pastel pink Art Deco hotel courtyard, 90s film aesthetic. A little girl in a hotel uniform walks slowly across the tiled courtyard, holding a short red string in her hand. The string connects upward to a large abstract white cloud floating 0.5 meters above her head, drifting along with her steps. When she reaches the middle of the courtyard, the cloud suddenly sneezes and makes a sneezing sound. She stops and looks up at it. As it sneezes, it grows bigger and turns dark grey with thunder and rain, and the whole courtyard darkens with it. After sneezing, it reverts back to a white cloud of the original size and the courtyard brightens again.
